label: Jehoiada

text.BHSA 1CH 12:26: מִן־בְּנֵי֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:26: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
text.BHSA 1CH 12:27: וִיהֹויָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמֹּ֕ו שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:27: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
text.BHSA 1CH 12:28: וְצָדֹ֥וק נַ֖עַר גִּבֹּ֣ור חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:28: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

A.name: Jehoiada
family: father-of benaiah (Benaiah, over the Cherethites and the Pelethites (2SA 8:18), the fift)

B.name: Jehoiada
B.line: Leader of the Aaronite priests who joined David at Hebron with 3,700 men
family: commander-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

why: The Hebrew identifies Jehoiada as הַנָּגִיד לְאַהֲרֹן, the leader of the Aaronites, accompanied by 3,700 men—exactly B’s stated office and contingent. The surrounding verses list Levites and Zadok; they do not identify this Jehoiada as Benaiah’s father.
